digest.component_or_area: agent guidance and ChatGPT workflow documentation
propositions: ChatGPT sessions with GitHub connector but no local Rebar tracker worktree, native CLI, or network access cannot safely create native tickets and require a documented fallback workflow.

Native ticket creation is impossible precisely when both the tracker-worktree dimension fails (no accessible tickets branch checkout) AND the network/remote dimension fails or the native rebar/rebar-mcp binary is unavailable.

The fallback payload must conform to export.schema.json's actual required fields (schema_version, ticket_id, ticket_type, title, status) plus description and parent_id; ticket_id is an agent-generated UUID4 that becomes source_id on rebar import, making re-import idempotent.

rebar import is the only sanctioned exceptional ingest path; it accepts NDJSON (not raw events), assigns fresh local ids and HLC timestamps, and in --dry-run mode silently skips records missing ticket_id/ticket_type without warning or counter increment.
Malformed records in dry-run mode are detectable by comparing would_create + skipped against total record count; any shortfall indicates missing-required-field records.
Guidance must state that GitHub is a read-only mirror for code changes and require search-before-create and native parent/child creation whenever the live tracker is accessible.
